title: All active volcanoes vs officially designated 'Decade Volcanoes'

source.name: Ring of Fire / Decade Volcanoes program summaries

notes: Of the roughly 1,400 volcanoes considered active, only 16 are officially designated 'Decade Volcanoes' by IAVCEI/the UN's International Decade for Natural Disaster Reduction, chosen for their history of destructive eruptions and proximity to populated areas.
